title: Adaptive Crop Refinement for RGB Visual Grounding
abstract: We refine coarse RGB grounding boxes with an adaptive crop module and report Acc@0.5 on a labeled RGB benchmark.

title: A Survey of Municipal Bond Pricing
abstract: This survey reviews yield curve models for municipal bonds and has no vision or grounding component.

title: 基于自适应裁剪的RGB视觉定位
abstract: 本文提出一种面向RGB图像的自适应裁剪视觉定位方法，并在标注基准上报告 Acc@0.5。

title: Adaptive Cropping for Video Action Recognition
abstract: We use adaptive crops to recognize actions in videos. The crop module is reusable, but the task is action recognition rather than visual grounding.

title: Clinical Visual Grounding for Radiology Reports
abstract: We ground findings in chest X-rays with clinician labels and report clinical accuracy.

title: Referring Expression Comprehension with Coarse Boxes
abstract: A language-vision model grounds referring expressions using coarse boxes. Overlap with RGB grounding is partial and the evaluation protocol differs.

title: Generic Object Detection Survey
abstract: A broad survey of object detection. It mentions bounding boxes but does not study grounding, crop refinement, or project-specific evaluation.

title: Unrelated but High Scoring Placeholder
abstract: Direct RGB visual grounding with adaptive crops and labeled Acc@0.5, included to test skip routing.

title: Maybe Grounding, Maybe Retrieval
abstract: The abstract mentions localization and retrieval without making the task identity clear.
